metaData.originalTitle: 面向 Skills 编程-淘宝企业购端对端研发提效实践
metaData.title: Skills-Oriented Programming - End-to-End R&D Efficiency Improvement for Taobao Enterprise Purchase
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: This article proposes the "Skills-Oriented Programming" paradigm, which encapsulates domain knowledge, workflows, and constraint rules into versionable Skill units, enabling LLMs to generate code within a deterministic framework. This achieves a 65% reduction in end-to-end delivery cycles for enterprise customer integration scenarios, with a 90% first-pass code generation success rate.
metaData.summary: This article from the Taobao Technology team systematically proposes and implements a new AI R&D paradigm called "Skills-Oriented Programming." Using Taobao Enterprise Purchase's custom customer integration scenario as a practical case, it details a five-stage evolution path from Vibe Coding, Prompt Templates, SDD (Specification-Driven Development), to Skill Encapsulation and Cloud Integration. The core idea is to encapsulate human domain experience (workflows, knowledge, constraints) into reusable Skill units, allowing AI to execute code generation within a defined framework rather than generating freely. The article deeply analyzes the bottlenecks encountered at each stage (e.g., AI hallucination, long-context collapse, lack of domain knowledge) and corresponding engineering solutions (script extraction, architecture decomposition, sub-Skills, constraint iteration). It also shares specific methodologies like layered architecture design, vertical domain Skill construction, a four-layer quality control system, and knowledge base building. The final result in the product domain was a reduction in delivery cycle from 23.5 person-days to 8 person-days (65% efficiency improvement) and a 90% first-pass code generation success rate. The article is not just a technical practice report but also offers profound insights into the changing role of developers in the AI era (from code executors to architects and AI mentors).

mainPoints.point: The core of "Skills-Oriented Programming" is encapsulating human domain experience into deterministic units executable by AI.
mainPoints.explanation: Skills encapsulate workflows (SKILL.md), domain knowledge (references), and constraint rules, transforming AI from a "free-form" conversational model to an engineering model that executes within a defined framework, solving the problem of unstable AI output quality.

mainPoints.point: The quality bottleneck in AI-driven R&D is not the model, but knowledge engineering.
mainPoints.explanation: The article points out that the improvement from 50% to 90% success rate came entirely from knowledge injection and constraint iteration, not from switching to a more powerful model. Domain knowledge (e.g., mapping rules, API signatures) must be explicitly injected through Skills and cannot emerge from training data.

mainPoints.point: Combining deterministic engineering with uncertain AI is key to building a controllable R&D pipeline.
mainPoints.explanation: High-precision tasks (e.g., interface extraction) are handled with deterministic scripts; unstable model tasks (e.g., long document generation) are bypassed through architecture decomposition (sub-Skills); and recurring error patterns are solidified into constraint rules. This combination turns uncontrollable conversations into reproducible pipelines.

mainPoints.point: Layered architecture is the infrastructure for AI programming, significantly improving AI generation quality.
mainPoints.explanation: Through a layered design of atomic capability layer, template layer, and adapter layer, the AI's scope is narrowed from "understanding the entire system" to "filling in adapter logic within a fixed framework." This reduces the adapter layer code volume by 60%, greatly lowering the complexity and error probability of AI generation.

keyQuotes: Skills are the smallest reusable unit for AI R&D: analogous to how 'functions/classes' encapsulate logic in software engineering, Skills encapsulate workflows + domain knowledge + constraint rules.

The quality bottleneck is not the model, but knowledge engineering: the improvement from 50% to 90% came entirely from knowledge injection and constraint iteration, not from switching to a more powerful model.
Deterministic engineering + uncertain AI = a controllable R&D pipeline.
The developer's role shifts from a code executor to a reviewer and architect.

relatedArticles.title: Architecture Design for LLMs: What Makes a Truly AI-Friendly Architecture?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically elaborates on the three paradigms of evolution from traditional engineering architecture to AI-Friendly architecture (deterministic → probabilistic, structured → semantic, static → dynamic). It also provides a detailed explanation of core capabilities such as Multi-Agent, Context Engineering, AI-Friendly APIs, and AI Observability, using the practical implementation of AI review and Q&A systems in Taobao's flash sale business as a case study.

relatedArticles.title: 97.9% Acceptance Rate, Glue Programming: Best Practices for Business Requirement Code Generation [Tmall AI Coding Practice Series]
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: The Tmall team shares the 'Glue Programming' AI-assisted development methodology. By building a four-layer material system consisting of task specifications, development standards, code patterns, and domain knowledge, they have increased the business code acceptance rate to over 90%.

relatedArticles.title: Investing 10,000 RMB in AI: A Year of Tools, Practices, and Reflections
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A systematic summary of a veteran developer's practical experience in the AI wave, covering everything from MAC toolchain optimization and Harness Engineering architectural constraints to building an Agent-driven automated learning loop.

relatedArticles.title: AI R&D Automation: Wiki Knowledge Base + Skill Pack
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to build a continuously growing team knowledge base and a supporting expert skill pack based on the LLM-Wiki model and the Obsidian platform to achieve AI-driven R&D automation.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: How I Spent a Week Boosting AI Coding Rate to 90% in an Enterprise App
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically introduces Harness Engineering, a new AI coding paradigm that elevates the AI code rate of an enterprise Java application from 25% to over 90% by building a four-element system of rules, skills, knowledge, and change management.

relatedArticles.title: In-Depth Analysis of AI-Generated UI Technology: Model Streaming Output and UI Rendering Practices
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically analyzes the core technologies of AI-Generated UI, focusing on the engineering practices of large language model streaming output and frontend UI rendering, covering streaming transmission protocols, mainstream open-source architectures, core challenges of streaming rendering, and AI editor implementations.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Is Not the Goal, Knowledge Is the Moat — Knowledge Accumulation Practices of an AI Engineering Delivery Team
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the engineering delivery practices of an AI Team, this article proposes that knowledge accumulation is more important than workflow orchestration, and systematically introduces a complete methodology encompassing a five-layer knowledge storage architecture, a three-level maturity system, and how workflows serve knowledge accumulation.

relatedArticles.title: Understanding Hermes in One Article: How the New Top-Tier Agent Self-Evolves from Experience
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the core innovation of the Hermes Agent—the Skills closed-loop system—detailing its complete implementation mechanism, from experience extraction and knowledge storage to intelligent retrieval and self-improvement, along with its engineering trade-offs and security considerations.

relatedArticles.title: Full-Stack RAG Technology Deep Dive
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically breaks down the core technologies of the full-stack RAG pipeline from a practical perspective, covering document loading, intelligent chunking, index construction, retrieval optimization, generation tuning, advanced Graph RAG, and the Ragas automated evaluation framework, emphasizing measurable, tunable, and trustworthy engineering practices.

relatedArticles.title: Practices and Reflections on a Real-Time Inference Commodity Domain Agent at the 10,000-Level
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the architecture of a real-time inference commodity domain Agent built by the Taobao Commodity Center team, which adopts an event-driven, Function-Centric design. By standardizing encapsulation via AIFunction, establishing a three-tier knowledge base system, unifying online and offline workflows, and leveraging transactional domain events, the architecture enables intelligent understanding and real-time inference for hundreds of millions of products, significantly improving information completeness and R&D efficiency.
